request: Could the colour theme go purple instead of mint? Mint feels a bit cold for how I use it every day, and purple is easier on my eyes.
I want the target to start at 150 instead of 100 so I do not have to type it in every time I open the app.
I would like the app called Everyday since it is the thing I open each morning, so the name should match that habit.
The plum colour is too dull for me, so the theme could turn orange. It makes the numbers much easier to spot at a glance.
The goal should begin at 750000 rather than 500000, because that is the number my shop has to reach this year, and it saves me typing it each time.
Let the target begin at 15 instead of 5, since that is how many I usually manage, so I get a head start every time I open it.
Name the app Ledger, since that is the word I use for the accounts, and it fits my tailoring work far better than the old name did.
Pocket Planner suits this much better than the old name, because the app tracks my salary growth and the name should say so.
Renaming the app to My Tracker would help, since I use it to log field sales and the old name made no sense to my team at all.
I want the target at 40 now, not 20, because my coach raised it and I keep forgetting to change it by hand.
Could the app be called The Book instead of Physio? It is the book I keep my exercises in, and the name would match what I put in it.
I would love the app called My Corner, because it is my own space for the desk, and the old name Pod Desk sounds like a company.
The target could begin at 6 instead of 3, because my baking runs in batches of six and that is the number I aim for each week.
Call the app Daily Log, because I will be writing my plank times down every day and that is really what it is for.
Pocket Planner would be a better name since I track my bike miles in it, and the word Mileage did not tell me what the app does.
Ledger is a good name now because it keeps my street chanda payments in one place, which the old name never told me.
Switch the app to dark mode, because I use it late at night and the bright screen is hard on my eyes when I am tired.
I want the name to be Keeper instead of Baby milk, because it keeps track of my baby's feeds and the new name feels warmer to me.
